mainmenu.help: 用法: !freefrag [PURPLE][快捷命令] [选项][NORMAL] 没有指定快捷命令时，该指令会打开预瞄插件主菜单。 支持的快捷指令： [PURPLE]prac[NORMAL] [1-{0}]: 开始选定编号的训练。 [PURPLE]map[NORMAL] [地图名]: 更换到指定的地图。 [PURPLE]df[NORMAL] [1-6]: 设置难度 [PURPLE]mode[NORMAL] [rand/full]: 设置训练模式。 [PURPLE]bw[NORMAL] [rand/ump/ak/sct/awp/pistol/eco/force]: 设置 bot 所使用的武器。 [PURPLE]gun[NORMAL] [ak/m4/m4a1s/awp/deagle/usp/glock/none]: Set your weapon. [PURPLE]jitter[NORMAL] [0-64]: Set bot spawn offset. [PURPLE]repeat[NORMAL] [n/inf/off]: Repeat the current route. [PURPLE]autoskip[NORMAL] [n/off]: Skip route after deaths. [PURPLE]hs[NORMAL] [on/off]: Headshot-only damage. [PURPLE]xray[NORMAL] [on/off]: Outline bots through walls. [PURPLE]botsfire[NORMAL] [on/off]: Bots shoot back. [PURPLE]bothealth[NORMAL] [1-1000]: Set bot health. [PURPLE]botarmor[NORMAL] [0-100]: Set bot armor. [PURPLE]countdown[NORMAL] [0-5]: Seconds the start is held (0 = off). [PURPLE]comp[NORMAL] [on/off]: Lock the settings above so times are comparable. [PURPLE]lang[NORMAL] [en/pt/zh]: 修改语言设定。en for English, pt para português, 中文选择 zh。 [PURPLE]top[NORMAL] [1-{0}] [comp]: Show the top 5 runs for a route. [PURPLE]stats[NORMAL]: Show your best times on this map. [PURPLE]binds[NORMAL]: Show the console line that binds arrow keys, Enter and Backspace to the menu. [PURPLE]exit[NORMAL]: 强制退出当前训练。
